objective: Replace the default live Vietnamese STT provider with pinned Moonshine Voice 0.0.73 while preserving the Hina SttProvider contract and an explicit faster-whisper rollback option.
non_goals: Do not claim a Vietnamese accuracy winner without a same-corpus Hina benchmark.
Do not remove the already proven faster-whisper provider or its cached weights.
Do not retain microphone audio or train from owner speech.
Do not promote Moonshine Vietnamese weights for commercial/public use while their non-commercial model license remains unresolved.
contracts: Moonshine is the default provider and language remains locked to vi/transcribe.
The provider consumes normalized 16 kHz mono samples and returns the existing SttResult contract.
Model loading remains lazy, bounded and local; failures return stable errors instead of fake transcripts.
HINA_STT_PROVIDER=faster-whisper is the documented rollback switch.
Raw owner audio is never persisted by Hina.
allowed_dependencies: Moonshine Vietnamese Base weights downloaded through the upstream verified manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover lazy Moonshine loading, Vietnamese transcription mapping, timeout drain and provider selection.
Runtime status reports Moonshine as the configured provider.
Dependency and model license provenance is recorded.
The existing speech unit suite remains green.
